# Bunny

> Bunny is an independent app for couples on iPhone and iPad. Connected partners care for one pet and exchange text love letters free. Bunny Pro adds the shared drawing canvas, with weekly and one-time lifetime purchase options.

Made by Prafull Sharma, Bunny started as a present for his girlfriend before he opened it up for other couples. The origin story and contact details are public at https://www.bunnycouples.com/about/.

## What Bunny Does

Bunny gives a couple a shared space. Inside Bunny you and your partner:

- Raise a cute virtual pet and grow a personalized plant together
- Doodle and draw together on a shared whiteboard/canvas
- See the shared whiteboard drawing in a small, medium, or large Home Screen widget
- Send love letters and notes that arrive with a delivery animation
- Answer couple question packs and compare your answers
- Send virtual gifts and affection
- Check in with each other every day

It is built to help partners feel close through small, shared daily rituals, including in a long-distance relationship.

## Who Bunny Is For

- Long-distance couples who want to feel present with each other between calls
- Any couple who wants playful, low-effort ways to stay connected
- People who currently juggle several apps (a pet app, a widget app, a questions app) and want one place
- Couples who prefer a one-time price over a recurring subscription

## Key Features

- **Shared virtual pet & plant**: connected partners care for the same pet, sharing its name, mood and Feed/Play/Water timers. Partners can visit at different times; an internet connection is needed to sync care updates
- **Draw-together canvas (Pro)**: one editable whiteboard for doodles; both partners can contribute, together or at different times
- **Home Screen drawing widget**: displays the shared whiteboard; separate love-note, day-count, and photo widgets are not currently offered
- **Text love notes & letters (free)**: write messages and reread sent and received letters in the mailbox; distinct from the editable drawing canvas
- **Couple question packs**: answer prompts and compare your answers
- **Virtual gifts**: surprise your partner
- **Daily check-ins**: a steady, low-pressure way to stay close

## Why Choose Bunny

Bunny brings a shared pet and text love letters into one couples app. Basic care and the mailbox are free. Partners can visit at different times and share the same pet name, mood and care timers. For couples who want to draw together without recurring payments, lifetime Pro provides a one-time purchase option for the shared whiteboard and its Home Screen widget. A separate weekly Pro subscription is also available.

## Platform & Pricing

- Platform: iPhone and iPad, via the App Store; no Android version currently
- Language: app interface and built-in questions are English; Japanese localization is not currently available
- Price: Free basic bunny care and text letters; shared whiteboard requires Bunny Pro. Weekly and lifetime purchases are available; prices vary by region and offer
- Category: Lifestyle: relationships & couples
